expectations.evidence: The time budget adds up to exactly 180 minutes. The section 4 table gives 60 + 45 + 45 + 15 + 15 minutes, and the weekly schedule in section 5 gives 60 + 45 + 45 + 30 minutes. Section 9 also cuts the plan to about 1 hour a month if Product Hunt traffic stays near zero. One point is deducted because some slots look too small for the work assigned to them. In 45 minutes, the maker has to try 4 to 6 products and write a substantive comment on each. In 60 minutes, they have to write the forum thread and also answer every reply that week. expectations.text: Fits the recommended plan inside roughly 3 hours a month
expectations.evidence: The section is titled 'The 180 minutes a month', and its blocks add up to exactly 180 (45+30+30+20+30+15+10). It also caps the work explicitly: 'Don't spend more than about 3 hours a month here', with a rule to cut to 60 min if Product Hunt drives no signups. One point off because the Cadence section is muddled. Block 1 runs only once, block 4 is quarterly with its minutes 'folded into block 1 in other months', and block 7 is missing from the cadence. The real monthly load is therefore unclear, though it never goes over the 3-hour budget.
